tool_args.rationale: The original contrast law failed confirmation. Across eight rows, the response shows a smooth opposing-step effect that decays with horizon, while the equal-step observation gives y=x_now. Fit the decaying contrast together with state and current-input contributions using all paid rows; no available probe better resolves the unsupported coupled-ODE or long-horizon alternatives.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Only three additional rows were available, below the documented minimum of eight; mem_conv is zero throughout, so its rates remain poorly identified.
No slow-horizon discriminating probe was available, and these observations do not establish its long-horizon reversal.
Its fresh-confirmation RMSE was 0.145753, well above 0.045, indicating the contrast-only form is inadequate.
Observed responses are smooth and step-opposed rather than chaotic or non-stationary; a state-anchored decaying contrast remains testable.
